snippet.title: TUNIC (GBC Demake) - Full Walkthrough (+secret ending)
snippet.description:
Play the demake:
https://mintferret.itch.io/tunicdemake

Last month, I released a demake of my favorite indie game of 2022 to the Gameboy Color with GB Studio. I noticed that not everybody found out about the secret ending. 

This was recorded using BGB's built-in recorder.
